title: v19/v21 minimap fix
author: NahidaIg
excerpt: Some gpus and windows versions will give you an issue with using the flyff v19 minimap that's included in just about every release, and it's because no one bothered to read and learned some DirectX in reference to a fixed function
body_html:
Some gpus and windows versions will give you an issue with using the flyff v19 minimap that's included in just about every release, and it's because no one bothered to read and learned some DirectX in reference to a fixed function pipeline...

Read more
excerpt_zh: 部分 GPU 和 Windows 版本下，FlyFF V19 小地图（几乎所有发行版都内置）会显示异常，原因是 DirectX 固定管线渲染问题。
summary_zh: NahidaIg 发布 V19/V21 小地图修复：部分显卡与 Windows 版本组合下，几乎所有发行版都内置的 FlyFF V19 小地图会出现渲染异常，根因是 DirectX 固定功能管线相关代码，作者在文中详细说明了修复方案。
